text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like the training paid off.
It felt like a really good run, too."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
............
This is no time to get carried away.
I simply achieved the expected result.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Today's victory is in the past.
Preparations for the next race have already begun."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Still not enough.
I need to stack up more victories, even just one more."

Admire Vega looked satisfied,
yet she didn't let her guard down for a second!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You don't need to tell me that. I know.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll keep running. I'll keep winning.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely make it happen.
I'll become the brightest shining star—"

Admire Vega gazed straight ahead, but beneath her calm
expression, I could feel her thrilling excitement for victory!
